title: Gwynn Blade
description: This mod adds three unique items to the game that can be used for both offense and defense. It features the Ignis Crucible, Heart Bound Brand, Cinder Step Sandals.
body:
This mod is compatible for minecraft version 1.21 features three unique items that add chaos as well as movement mechanics to the game. 

1. Cinder Step Sandals - The cinder step sandals are a pair of sandals a player can use to move around quickly by pressing right click on their mouse, it hurls the player in the direction of their crosshair and if there is an obstacle in front of the player and the player hits the obstable, it damages the nearby mobs through an explosion but not the player.

2. Hearth Bound Brand - This brand is a unique item that is used for escaping tricky situations by setting a teleportation point at a block by shift+right clicking the block and right clicking the brand again to teleport to the marked location from anywhere. This can also be used as a weapon as it deals massive damage to the mob the player hits, on a condition just like the mace but different. When the player is falling down, it negates the fall damage dealt to the player and instead causes an explosion to spawn on the mob the player hits upon landing if the player times the hit on the mob before landing.

3. Ignis Crucible - The Ignis Crucible is lets the player perform pyromancy using it. The player can collect any source of fire or lava in the igns crucible by right the source and it and can shoot it out as a fireball when shift+right click is pressed.
